description: This file contains the implementation of a configuration validator class for ADO.NET Streaming options in the Orleans framework. It validates various properties of the AdoNetStreamOptions to ensure they meet certain constraints.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamOptionsValidator
classes.description: A class that validates the AdoNetStreamOptions configuration, ensuring all property values meet the required constraints.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the AdoNetStreamOptions properties and throws exceptions if any property does not satisfy the specified constraints.
